newsitem.title: USA: Safety-Kleen Q1 net falls on lube oil slump. [CORRECTED 09:00 GMT 12/4]
newsitem.headline: Safety-Kleen Q1 net falls on lube oil slump. [CORRECTED 09:00 GMT 12/4]

text.p: Safety-Kleen Corp said Friday its earnings in the first quarter ended March 22 fell from year-ago levels in part because of continued lower prices in the lube oil market.

The company reported net income of $11.8 million, or $0.20 a share, compared with $13.1 million, or $0.23, a year ago. Sales in the period rose to $220.2 million from $201.7 million (Corrects sales figures from $59.3 million and $54.6 million respectively).

As the company announced in early March, its Oil Recovery Services division posted an after-tax loss of about $730,000 in the most recent quarter, compared with after-tax earnings of $860,000 last year because of the oil price decline.
Safety-Kleen said it does not expect prices to return to historical levels in the near future.
The environmental and industrial services company's shares closed off 5/8 Friday at 14-1/4.
